notes.title: Graphics and performance improvements
notes.notes:
- Higher resolution menus and text.
- Fixed particle bug that affected performance.
- Fixed rare bug where weapon fire rate would be slowed down.

notes.title: Bug fixes and improvements
notes.notes:
- Music on High Ground now looping correctly
- Fixed rare crash that could happen after pausing when wall sliding
- The Crusher cannot be shot from the side
- Info-bots are easier to get on first few levels
- Better AI on Survival 3

notes.title: small bug fixes
notes.notes:
- Fixed health pointer which did not disappear if health kits were crushed by platforms.
- Detonators can now be crushed by platforms

notes.title: Survival Mode added!
notes.notes: In Survival Mode your objective is to stay alive for as long as possible in three new arenas. This new mode is unlocked by finishing the main campaign.
